data.narrative:
Skeleton Technologies is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised €392M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of nine frontier-tech peers in Climate & Energy: one public company (Linamar, LNZA) and eight private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. A formal peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient datapoints at the same or adjacent stage within similar valuation tiers.

The Stage-Progression method was applied, treating the €392M in total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E to next-stage progression. This approach yielded an implied valuation of €549M. This method is appropriate given the company's late-stage positioning and the difficulty in isolating narrow peer multiples.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €466M to €631M, centered on a median of €549M. The wide band reflects reliance on a single method and the inherent uncertainty in frontier-tech valuation given limited operating history and market comparability. Key uncertainties include market adoption timelines, capital intensity requirements through later funding rounds, and the relative performance of Skeleton against the broader Climate & Energy peer cohort. Additional stage-specific transaction data or revenue-based approaches would strengthen conviction in a narrower range.
